about: Exodus means "going out." It tells how God set His people free from Egypt and taught them how to live.

pages.title: Baby in a Basket
pages.scene: Baby Moses in a basket in the river reeds, Miriam watching
pages.text: The king of Egypt was mean to God's people. So one mom hid her baby boy in a basket. She set it in the tall grass by the river. His big sister Miriam watched. The king's daughter found the baby and loved him. She named him Moses.

pages.title: The Burning Bush
pages.scene: Moses kneeling before the burning bush
pages.text: Moses grew up and took care of sheep. One day he saw a bush on fire, but it did not burn up! God spoke from the bush. "My people are hurting," God said. "Go to the king and tell him to let them go." Moses was scared, but God said, "I will be with you."
pages.lesson: God sees people who are hurting, and He helps.

pages.title: Let My People Go
pages.scene: Moses talking to Pharaoh, with frogs on the floor
pages.text: Moses told the king, "Let God's people go!" But the king said no. So God sent frogs, bugs, hail and darkness. Each time the king still said no. At last God sent one more terrible plague. Then the king finally said, "Go!" God's people left Egypt that very night.

pages.title: A Path Through the Sea
pages.scene: God's people walking through the parted sea
pages.text: The king changed his mind and chased God's people. They were stuck at the sea! Moses held out his stick. God blew a strong wind, and the water opened up. The people walked through on dry ground! When they were safe, the water closed again. Miriam and the people sang and danced to thank God.
pages.lesson: When you are stuck, God can make a way.

pages.title: Bread from Heaven
pages.scene: People gathering manna in the desert
pages.text: In the desert the people were hungry and grumpy. God said, "I will send bread from heaven." Every morning, sweet flakes called manna covered the ground. There was enough for everyone, every day. When they were thirsty, God gave them water from a rock!
pages.lesson: God gives us what we need each day.

pages.title: Ten Good Rules
pages.scene: Moses holding the two stone tablets on the mountain
pages.text: On a big mountain, God gave Moses ten rules on stone. Love God most of all. Don't make idols. Use God's name with respect. Rest on God's day. Obey your mom and dad. Don't hurt people. Be faithful. Don't steal. Don't lie. Don't wish for what others have.
pages.lesson: God's rules help us love Him and love each other.

pages.title: The Golden Calf
pages.scene: People dancing around the golden calf
pages.text: Moses was on the mountain a long time. The people got tired of waiting. They made a statue of a calf out of gold and danced around it. That made God sad. Moses prayed for the people, and God forgave them. God gave Moses the rules again on new stones.
pages.lesson: Worship only God, and wait for Him.

pages.title: A Tent for God
pages.scene: The tabernacle tent with God's cloud over it
pages.text: God told His people to make a special tent called the tabernacle. Everyone brought gifts: gold, cloth and wood. Skilled workers made it beautiful. When it was finished, God's cloud filled the tent. God was living right there with His people!
pages.lesson: Give your best to God, because He is with us.
